features: MASSIVE BASS: Press the ULT button to boost your bass & feel the incredible power of sound
PREMIUM NOISE CANCELING: Get closer to your favorite music with dual noise canceling technology & V1 processor
COMFORTABLE DESIGN: Unique thermo-foaming design for smooth cushions that comfortably mold to your ears
LONG BATTERY LIFE & QUICK CHARGING: Up to 50-hours battery life with ANC OFF and 30-hours with ANC on and a quick charging (10 min. charge for up to 5 Hours of music)
MULTIPOINT CONNECTION: Connect two devices at once
LESS WIND NOISE: Mesh around the mic reduces wind and background noise so you can focus on your favorite music and conversations
INTELLIGENT WEARING DETECTION: A capacitive sensor knows when your headphones are on and off for instant pause and play
description: Massive Bass. Ultimate Vibe. Feel like you’ve dived into the front row of the concert and turn the moment on with the ULT POWER SOUND series. Built for music lovers, it produces powerful deep sound designed to make your heart tremble. Prepare to feel the bass. Live the experience with your sound sanctuary. Press the ULT button for powerful sound, thanks to the specially designed 40 mm driver unit and Integrated Processor V1. Enjoy precise, punchy, high-quality sound that gets you as close to the original recording as possible. Unleash the power. Just you and your music. With Dual Noise Sensor technology and the Integrated Processor V1, ULT WEAR takes digital Noise Cancelling to the next level. Now you can truly shut out the world and enjoy a party for one – just you and your music. Superb sound, refined design. The ULT WEAR is designed to fit your style. Cool, comfortable, and built for powerful, high-quality sound. Made to move with you. The ULT WEAR exudes function, form, and features. A sensor pauses your music when you take them off and starts again when you put them on, and Bluetooth pairs with two devices at the same time. Ideal for everyday use.
